notes.title: V1.01 Version update
notes.notes:
1. Fix the bug that the cloud archive does not take effect
2. Fix the multilingual display bug of steam achievements

notes.title: V.021 Update
notes.notes:
1. Reduce the store refresh price
2. Reduce the price of items in the store
3. Reduce monster attack

notes.title: V0.2 update patch
notes.notes:
1. Added a new character "Teacher Ma"
2. New weapon "Lightning Pentacle"
3. Add achievements to new weapons and characters
4. The super weapon attack of the weapon "wheel" has been changed from launching 5 tires at a time to: increase the size of the tires, and the tires can rebound 3 times after hitting the wall
5. The super weapon attack of the weapon "Explosive Staff" has been changed from launching 5 magic balls at a time to: after the explosion, it can explode to the surroundings multiple times
6. Reduce the attack of monsters and reduce the difficulty of the game
7. Some bug fixes

notes.title: V0.12 version update:
notes.notes:
Function iteration:
1. New battle saving function: the game will not lose battle data after exiting the game or closing it accidentally (such as crash, etc.), and you can continue the game from the main interface;
Bug fixes:
1. The melee weapons attack animation is abnormal when attack speed reduced to a negative number BUG repair
2. Some achievements and characters cannot be unlocked BUG repair
3. The game failure will not settle the achievement BUG repair
